note: SPEC §4 escaping/width battery, §8.4. For each case, canonical_json(body) MUST equal the bytes in canon_hex and SHA-256 of those bytes MUST equal warrant_id. Bodies are given with ensure_ascii escaping so this file is pure ASCII; the escapes are JSON transport, not canonical output. schema_valid says whether the body is also §2-schema-valid: canonicalization is independent of schema validity, and one case (a 201-code-point note) is canonical-and-invalid on purpose. Every control code point U+0000..U+001F appears, plus the JCS reimplementation traps: the \b/\f short forms, U+2028/29 and <>& raw-emission, NFC vs NFD (never normalized), astral planes, and the 200-code-point note boundary.
